bio: Housed in Jinricksha Station, a former rickshaw depot circa 1903, Born boasts a modern dining room adorned by glowing double arches, high glass ceiling and an ethereal paper sculpture. A protégé of André Chiang, Chef Zor Tan cooks up a 9-course tasting menu inspired by the circle of life and his personal journey, melding French gastronomy with Chinese cooking. Dishes are creative and crafted with globally sourced ingredients, delivering contrasts in textures and flavours....
